target_customer: Developers building AI agents and companies that want governed access to tools via MCP
problem: Connecting agents and AI clients to many tools through MCP needs hosting, auth, access control and logging. Metorial provides an open source gateway with one URL, SSO, role based access and tracing.
business_model: Open core with cloud usage plans: free Dev, 250 USD per month Scale, custom Enterprise

founders.name: Karim (Wen) Rahme
founders.background_notes: YC page: friends with Herber for over 10 years since a technical high school in Austria.

founders.name: Tobias Herber
founders.background_notes: YC bio calls him a 3x founder and IEEE best paper author.

competitors.name: Composio
competitors.what: Hosted integrations for agents, closed source with more integrations, per a Hacker News commenter

technical_complexity.rationale: Running many third party MCP servers in isolated containers with fast cold starts, auth and tracing is standard but non trivial infrastructure work for four people.

defensibility.rationale: Open source and a source available license invite copying. Enterprise SSO, audit and integrations add stickiness. Model labs are standardizing MCP features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Several MCP hosting startups raised funds in 2025 and 2026 (Alpic, Manufact, Runlayer per search results). No acquisition of Metorial found.

market_need_then: MCP adoption surged through 2025 and developers needed hosting and security for servers. The YC launch and Show HN (2025-10-14) pitched Vercel for MCP.

identity.visual_style: Developer infrastructure site with pricing tiers
identity.voice_and_tone: Developer friendly, positioned as Vercel for MCP, later as a governed MCP and skills gateway

branding.community_and_virality: Show HN post, Product Hunt launches and a public GitHub repository (3,300 plus stars per one directory, unverified)

brand_strength.rationale: Forbes listed it among top YC Fall 2025 startups and HN and Product Hunt launches gave visibility, but name is easy to confuse with similar sounding names and origin is unknown.

outcome_analysis: Metorial is active and early. Two long time friends who ran Valicit launched an open source MCP platform from YC Fall 2025, got Forbes and Hacker News attention, and later repositioned toward an enterprise MCP and skills gateway. No funding round was confirmed from a primary source, and a crowded field of funded MCP infrastructure startups is the main risk.
notes: Funding: nordic9 (2025-11-28) lists total 500K with Founder Factor, Orange Collective, Pioneer Fund and Valia Ventures; VCBacked and CB Insights give 500K with differing round labels and dates. These are aggregators with no amount for the round itself, so not recorded as rounds. Location: YC says Vienna, aggregators say San Francisco. License is reported as Functional Source License in an HN thread but Apache 2.0 elsewhere; unresolved. Founder education and employers beyond Valicit not found. Manufact is a different company. Completeness pass: the pre-seed dated 2025-11 rests on a single outlet (nordic9) with no round amount; CB Insights and VCBacked give about 500K total with other stage labels, so the amount is not assigned to the round.
